vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes from the OSV database replace Dependabot, which is disabled on this repo. They skip the weekly schedule so a fix does not wait for Monday.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for routine updates, so the noise stays at one review a week. Majors stay separate: they are the ones that break.
Patch and digest updates merge themselves once CI is green. The anki rule below overrides this.
Pin the Dockerfile base images by digest, so a rebuild cannot pull different base layers while git stays unchanged.
Only patch releases and digest updates of Python 3.12. A Python version bump is a deliberate change (the anki wheels have to support it), not a weekly update.

The anki pin owns the Anki collection's schema version. A newer one can force a full sync on the phone's AnkiDroid, so every bump gets its own PR and a manual gate. See README, 'Upgrading the anki package'.
prBodyNotes:
> [!WARNING]
> **This is a schema migration, not a routine update.** Before merging:
>
> 1. **Schema check.** Compare `SCHEMA_MAX_VERSION` in `rslib/src/storage/upgrades/mod.rs` and `SYNC_VERSION_MAX` in `rslib/src/sync/version.rs` between the old and new tags of `ankitects/anki`. The git tags are zero-padded: `26.08.1`, not `26.8.1`. If either changed, the phone's AnkiDroid must support the new version first, or it will demand a full sync.
> 2. Back up the data directory.
> 3. Rebuild, run the tests, use the tools once, then `sync_to_ankiweb`, and confirm the phone still syncs normally.
